claim.claim-text: 1. A pellicle frame configured to be releasably engageable with a patterning device suitable for use in a lithographic process, the pellicle frame comprising a tab which projects from an outer edge of the frame, the tab comprising an opening, and

an engagement mechanism having an outer wall correspondingly shaped to be received in the opening of the tab, wherein the engagement mechanism is part of a mount configured to provide a releasably engageable attachment between the patterning device and the pellicle frame.
2. The pellicle frame of claim 1, wherein the engagement mechanism comprises a locking member comprising one or more engagement arms.
3. The pellicle frame of claim 2, wherein the one or more engagement arms extend generally parallel to a plane of the pellicle frame or the patterning device.
4. The pellicle frame of claim 2, wherein the locking member further comprises a connecting member which extends between a pair of resilient arms.
5. The pellicle frame of claim 4, wherein the resilient arms are configured to flex in a direction which is generally perpendicular to a patterned surface of the patterning device.
6. The pellicle frame of claim 4, wherein the resilient arms are configured not to flex in directions which are generally parallel to a patterned surface of the patterning device.

7. The pellicle frame of claim 2, wherein the engagement arms of a first engagement mechanism extend generally parallel to the one or more arms of that engagement mechanism, and the engagement arms of a second engagement mechanism extend generally perpendicular to the one or more arms of that engagement mechanism.

8. The pellicle frame of claim 1, wherein a side of the pellicle frame is provided with a sub-mount which allows movement in a first direction and a sub-mount which allows movement in a second direction which is substantially perpendicular to the first direction
9. The pellicle frame of claim 8, wherein the sub-mounts are provided as complementary pairs at equivalent positions on opposite sides of the pellicle frame.

10. The pellicle frame of claim 1, wherein the tab is provided on a side of the pellicle frame oriented in the scanning direction or oriented perpendicular to the scanning direction during use in a lithographic apparatus.
11. The pellicle frame of claim 1, wherein the engagement mechanisms is configured to receive a protrusion.

12. The pellicle frame of claim 1, wherein the mount is configured to suspend the pellicle frame relative to the patterning device such that there is a gap between the pellicle frame and the patterning device.
13. The pellicle frame of claim 1, further comprising one or more recesses distributed around the pellicle frame.

14. A patterning device which is configured to be releasably attached the pellicle frame according to any one of claims 1 to 13, suitable for use in a lithographic process, comprising a protrusion located on a front surface or on a side of the patterning device, wherein the protrusion is part of a mount configured to suspend a pellicle frame relative to the patterning device such that there is a gap between the pellicle frame and the patterning device; and wherein the mount provides a releasably engageable attachment between the protrusion and an engagement mechanism of the pellicle frame.

15. A mask assembly comprising the patterning device of claim 14 which is releasably engaged with the pellicle frame according to any one of claims 1 to 13, such that there is a gap between the pellicle frame and the patterning device.
